ATLAS_presentation.source: ATLAS of Finite Groups, Conway et al.

protocol_steps.action: Construct the W33 generator matrices g1,g2 for PSp(4,3) in the 66-dim F2 representation (from the Pass 821 endomorphism certificate).
Verify g1^2=g2^5=(g1*g2)^6=(g1*g2^2)^9=[g1,g2]^2=1 mod 2 (ATLAS standard presentation for U4(2)).
Restrict g1,g2 to each composition factor subspace (dim 14, dim 6 twice, dim 40).
For the 6-dim factor: check that the restricted pair matches an ATLAS standard-generator entry for the natural U4(2) module by computing char poly and order.
For the 14-dim factor: match to the deleted permutation module by char poly.
For the 40-dim factor: match to the F4-extension by char poly over F4.
Declare the external ATLAS label once all char polys agree with catalogue entries.

theorem: A seven-step standard-generator conjugacy protocol is specified that will promote the Pass 851 dimension-and-invariant compatibility certificate to a full external ATLAS label for the 66-dimensional F2 W33 module.
boundary: This pass specifies and certifies the protocol. The actual execution is deferred to a subsequent generator-word pass.
